name: Flowernet
summary: Reported local Kalgoorlie ISP; flowernet.com.au was Hawkins Nursery + a member-login portal (ISP branding) 1997-2011; domain parked by Jan 2014, since deleted. No APNIC record.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture of flowernet.com.au (Oct 1997; local source places it in Kalgoorlie).

Site dead ~2011; domain parked Jan 2014, later deleted. No archived retail-ISP homepage exists for flowernet.com.au — flower/horticulture content from the first capture (Oct 1997) onwards; the claimed 2011-13 death dates only the florist shop → parked domain transition.

refs.label: even the earliest capture (10 Oct 1997) is a florist/horticulture page — no retail ISP content exists in the archive record
2007-2009: purely florist e-commerce; domain parked/blank by 14 Jan 2014
Flowernet was a florist-network trademark (The Flower Company Aus Pty Ltd), filed Aug 1996
